changelog: v1.3.8.3: Fixed Exclude UI hang and library reappearance by calling DeleteItem atomically before cleanup. Added TMDB/IMDb ID duplicate checks to prevent re-scraping existing library movies. Added 1tamilmv.capital domain mirror and dynamic redirect host resolution. Enforced UTC dateadded for accurate Recently Added sorting. Unified blocklist display with separate Title and TMDB ID columns.
description: Native Downloads ecosystem for Jellyfin. Scrapes external forums for new media and integrates with Seedr and Torbox for downloading.
name: JellyFetch
overview: External media scraper and download manager. Integrates Seedr and Torbox.
